notes.title: Big Update #1
notes.content:
[b]We have been working on the Hell Level, characters, and AI mostly for this update.
1. Rebuilt Hell Level (W.I.P.)with a New Underground Cave System to add immersion.
2. Added in a Short Cinematic at the beginning. (W.I.P.)
3. Changed out some of the sounds in the Hell Level to better fit the environment.
4. Added in New Creatures (Chaser, Human Mutant 1&3, Dark Lord, Evil Devil, Zombie Skeletons, and Inquisitor) W.I.P.
5. Fixed few issues with A.I. Attacks, Melee Traces, and Capsule Problem on Demon.
6. Added in 9 total New Areas (W.I.P.) to explore.
7. Added in Spawn Effect when player spawns in Hell Level (Cinematic coming soon).
8. Added in Brand New Guardian Angel that will follow and protect the player.
9. Added in Post Process Volumes and Luts to bring out that Cinematic Look during game play.
10. Rebuilt Exponential Height Fog and Lighting to fit the environment better.
11. Added in some different footstep sounds on Main Character(W.I.P.).
12. Added in more Worms, Bugs, Slithering things, and will be adding in more, or changing some out during future updates.
13. Changed/Fixed some settings in Light Maps, Culling, Collision, NavMesh Volumes.
14. Rebuilt Lighting and Post Process Volume in Tunnel.
15. Added in a few more animations on some of the A.I., and will be slowly adding in more attacks, sounds, and effects.[/b]

Adding in New Locations.
Added in Guardian Angel.

[/b]

notes.title: Version 3
notes.content:
[b]Total rebuild of levels(W.I.P.)[/b]
Added in basic loading screens. Will improve over time.
Added in few new additions to the New Hell Level.
Added in widget displaying Information at the beginning of the Hell Level, but took it out to improve it.
Added in Maze Area in Heaven Level with flowers, trees, and bushes.
Simple Optimization of all levels to perform at higher FPS for players with low end graphics cards.


[b]We are continuing to work mostly on the levels right now, and once that is complete we will move on to a lot of the other new additions that we already have planned.[/b]
